name: dimensions-field
title: Dimensions field
description: Width by height in one field, with a lock that keeps the aspect ratio: change either side and the other follows the ratio set when you locked it.
docs: value and onValueChange speak { width, height, locked }; a size is a number between min (1) and max, or null while its field is empty. The lock keeps the ratio the sizes had when it went on, so rounding never drifts. name adds hidden inputs <name>-width and <name>-height.
